critical_code_review_comments: ModePicker.jsx and Studio.jsx integration is clean — props (onPick / onComingSoon), keyboard-accessibility (buttons), data-testids on all three cards plus the composite badge, and the disabled (is-coming-soon) state are all correctly wired. The composite-card onClick branches via c.disabled so the parent's setMode never fires for composite — exactly matching the spec.

Minor: the toast message in Studio.jsx (line 686) is the single source of the Composite copy. Consider lifting it into a constant or i18n key alongside ModePicker.jsx so the picker badge text ('Rolling Out') and the toast wording stay in sync if either is changed.

Minor a11y: each mode-picker-card is a <button type='button'> (good) but the entire card is clickable while also containing a heading <h2>. Consider an aria-label on the button (e.g. aria-label='Select Avatar mode') so screen-reader announcements aren't dominated by the long blurb text. Not a blocker.
(Carried) Studio.jsx is now 1274 lines — the chip-row, scene-section, storyboard, active-grid, history-list could each be hooks/subcomponents.
